verdicts.reason: A keeps the reading order (brand, headline, copy, chips, CTA) but strings it down a narrow right column with huge empty gaps. The circle sits apart from the shoe instead of behind it, the body copy and chips are tiny, and the bottom third is dead space. B gives the headline and shoe good sizes, but the CTA shrinks to a tiny pill crammed at the top with the badges. The headline and the FREE DELIVERY tag collide with the orphaned circle, and GROVE drops below the headline, so the hierarchy is broken and the CTA is buried. A is slightly less bad.
